seed_selection_note: Fresh draft, window right-shifted to [9501,9900] (W58's seeds ran up to 9418). Intersection of that window with the freshly built roster index is the EMPTY SET; the largest indexed seed below 100000 is 9373. Term-popcount distribution over the 400: {"0": 40, "1": 120, "2": 153, "3": 76, "4": 11}. Selection maximised the MINIMUM per-term carrier count first, then total carrier slots, giving 9531/9532/9583/9839 at (min 2, total 16). This (2,16) is PROVABLY the global optimum for this window, not a heuristic's best guess: the window's highest popcount is 4, so four seeds can total at most 16 slots and 16 is attained; and min>=3 would need every one of the 7 terms covered by >=3 of the 4 seeds, i.e. >=21 slots > 16, which is arithmetically impossible. W58's 18 and W57's 21 are therefore NOT evidence of a degraded selection this round -- those windows happened to contain 5-term and 6-term seeds.
